concept: A month of round 44px days in a real grid: today ringed, the chosen day the loud solid, a range a band of chosen glass.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a calendar with square day cells, a blue chosen day and a light blue range
default_to_avoid.why_not: square cells and a blue choice bring a hue and a grid of lines; Pane uses round days and the loud solid

derivation.consequence: one solid fill exists, the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light); a promoted action is the same solid glowing with its own light, and a pane uses one of them
derivation.form: the chosen day is the one loud solid in the month and a range runs between two of them

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: today is ringed, the chosen day filled and a range banded, so each state reads by shape

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: every day is a 44px round target even in a dense month

variants.reason: A keeps the one solid for the choice (P5) and every state by shape (P6). B brings a hue and a grid of lines. C hides the shape of the month.

root.why: the header and the month stack with a small gap and never pass the column

head.why: the month name sits between the previous and next buttons

title.why: the month name is semibold at body size and announced when it changes

chev.why: the chevrons point back and forward and flip in RTL

grid.why: the month is a real table so rows and columns are read as weeks and days

wd.why: weekday names are short and secondary at caption size with their full names for readers

cell.why: each cell holds one day and carries the range band when it is inside a range

mid.why: a day inside a range sits on a band of chosen glass

start.why: the band starts at the centre of the first day

end.why: the band stops at the centre of the last day

day.why: each day is a round 44px button in tabular figures

out.why: days from the next and previous month are secondary

today.why: today is ringed with a hairline and set semibold

chosen.why: the chosen day and the ends of a range are the loud solid

off.why: an unavailable day is struck through and dimmed but stays in place

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

hover.why: a day takes the quiet surface under the pointer

focus-visible.why: the day in focus shows the ring inside its circle

aria-disabled.why: an unavailable day keeps no hover so it does not invite a press

background-color.why: the hover surface fades in on the hover ease
